race.comment: LOVE AND PAIN (3) is desperate to break through after three placings from as many runs this campaign, including a long-neck second at Ipswich before a wide-run third as favourite at Toowoomba. The inside draw and proven 800m record give her the most reliable profile. GENERAL DANCER (6) brings the sharpest recent track reference, having been beaten only a neck at this venue two starts back before a fair seventh at Grafton on soft ground. ROTH'S ROMANCE (11) was a big-odds improver at Gatton, closing off for fourth on soft going, and she has the upside to take another step if the quick back-up is handled. FLYING ZULU (5) is harder to trust off two plain Sunshine Coast runs but this does look easier. Third-up now and gets the blinkers on first time. Scope for sharp improvement. TROY BOY (10) best of the rest.
